description: This PHP source file defines the class RegistrationEmployeeTerminationEventProcessor, which extends AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor. The class processes employee termination events by fetching employee count data and determining if an event should be saved based on employee count changes. It utilizes traits and classes related to employee services and registration event queues within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: RegistrationEmployeeTerminationEventProcessor
classes.description: A processor class for handling employee termination related registration events in the HR system.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event, specifically associated with inactive employee count.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Gathers general registration data and appends the current employee count for termination-related events.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Determines whether the current event should be stored based on employee count thresholds.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the constant indicating an inactive employee count event.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Provides data related to the employee termination event, including current employee count.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Checks if the event should be saved based on employee count thresholds and change tracking size.
